game_concept: A card battler set in Eldritch Ruins – Overgrown Archway, a vine-choked archway: the rune scholar must handle vine horrors while practicing lists. Core idea – Slice Slicer: Cut lists with slices like items[1:4] to grab exactly the right group.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Overgrown Archway: a vine-choked archway
core_gameplay_loop: In Overgrown Archway, repeat each round: Cut lists with slices like items[1:4] to grab exactly the right group. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the slice_ok value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 9 consecutive correct decisions about slice_ok to power up the rune scholar and open the rune gate.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 4 (applied tier): Slice Slicer
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Slice Slicer' (Week 7 slot 3), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Overgrown Archway'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how slice_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against vine horrors in Overgrown Archway.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 9.
